entries.head: rustle up

senses.en: to make a meal quickly from what is available

example.en: I can rustle up some noodles if you're hungry.

entries.l1_note: 凑一顿是 rustle up，不是 make something random（中式）。

entries.head: cook up

senses.en: to prepare food, often quickly

example.en: He cooked up a huge breakfast for everyone.
example.zh: 他给大家做了一大桌早饭。

entries.l1_note: cook up 也指“编个说法”，看宾语是不是食物。

entries.head: stir in

senses.en: to mix an ingredient into a mixture

example.en: Stir in the flour a little at a time.

entries.l1_note: 拌入是 stir in；stir up 是煽动。

entries.head: mix in

senses.zh: 把一样东西混进另一样
senses.en: to add one thing and mix it with another

example.en: Mix in the eggs one by one.

entries.l1_note: 混入是 mix in；mix up 是弄混。

entries.head: fold in

senses.en: to gently combine a light mixture

example.en: Fold in the egg whites with a spatula.
example.zh: 用刮刀把蛋白翻拌进去。

entries.l1_note: 翻拌是 fold in，动作轻，别用 stir。

entries.head: boil over

senses.en: when liquid boils and spills out

example.en: Turn the heat down before the soup boils over.
example.zh: 汤扑出来之前把火关小。

entries.l1_note: 扑锅是 boil over；也指情绪爆发。

entries.head: boil down

senses.en: to cook liquid until it reduces

example.en: Let the sauce boil down for ten minutes.

entries.l1_note: 收汁是 boil down；归结为是 boil down to。

entries.head: fry up

senses.en: to cook something quickly in a pan

example.en: Fry up the leftover rice with two eggs.
example.zh: 把剩饭加两个蛋炒一下。

entries.l1_note: fry up 偏“随便煎一盘”，正式菜谱用 fry。

entries.head: soak up

senses.en: to absorb liquid

example.en: Use a paper towel to soak up the oil.

entries.l1_note: 吸掉是 soak up；soak in 是吸收进皮肤。

entries.head: drain off

senses.en: to remove liquid from food

example.en: Drain off the water before you add the sauce.

entries.l1_note: 沥掉是 drain off / drain；drain out 也有，但不常配食物。

entries.head: strain off

senses.en: to separate liquid from solid with a sieve

example.en: Strain off the oil and keep the chili flakes.

entries.l1_note: 滤掉是 strain off；strain 单独是拉伤。

entries.head: pour off

senses.en: to pour away the liquid on top

example.en: Pour off the fat before you reheat it.
example.zh: 加热前把上面的油倒掉。

entries.l1_note: 倒掉上层是 pour off；pour out 是倒出来。

entries.head: scoop out

senses.en: to remove something with a spoon

example.en: Scoop out the seeds before stuffing the pepper.
example.zh: 塞馅前把辣椒籽掏出来。

entries.l1_note: 掏空是 scoop out；挖一勺是 scoop。

entries.head: scoop up

senses.en: to lift something with a spoon

example.en: Scoop up the rice and pack it into the bowl.

entries.l1_note: 舀起是 scoop up；也指一把抱起。

entries.head: plate up

senses.en: to put food onto plates for serving

example.en: Plate up while it's still hot.

entries.l1_note: 装盘是 plate up，餐厅和短视频里常见。

entries.head: bag up

senses.en: to put things into bags

example.en: Bag up the leftovers and put them in the fridge.

entries.l1_note: 装袋是 bag up；打包盒是 box up。

entries.head: use up

senses.en: to finish all of something

example.en: Use up the eggs before they go bad.

entries.l1_note: 用光是 use up；run out 是没了。

entries.head: run low on

senses.en: to have only a little left

example.en: We're running low on rice — add it to the order.

entries.l1_note: 快没了是 run low on；用完是 run out of。

entries.head: rinse off

senses.en: to wash something quickly with water

example.en: Rinse off the vegetables before you chop them.

entries.l1_note: 冲掉是 rinse off；rinse out 是冲洗内部。

entries.head: scrub off

senses.en: to remove dirt by rubbing hard

example.en: Scrub off the burnt bits before you soak the pan.
example.zh: 泡锅之前把糊的地方刷掉。

entries.l1_note: 刷掉是 scrub off；scrub 单独是刷洗。

entries.head: clean out

senses.en: to empty and clean the inside of something

example.en: Clean out the fridge before the new groceries arrive.
example.zh: 新买的菜到之前把冰箱清空。

entries.l1_note: 清空内部是 clean out；clear out 是整间清空。

entries.head: toss out

senses.en: to throw something away

example.en: Toss out anything past the expiration date.

entries.l1_note: 扔掉是 toss out / throw out，美式口语常用。

entries.head: toss together

senses.en: to mix a dish quickly

example.en: Toss together a cucumber salad while the rice cooks.

entries.l1_note: 随手拌是 toss together；正式拌沙拉也用 toss。

entries.head: measure out

senses.en: to take an exact amount

example.en: Measure out two cups of rice first.

entries.l1_note: 量出是 measure out；measure 单独是测量。

entries.head: portion out

senses.en: to divide food into individual amounts

example.en: Portion out the rice for tomorrow's lunch.

entries.l1_note: 分份是 portion out；分给别人是 dish out。

entries.head: heat through

senses.en: to heat food until it is hot all the way through

example.en: Stir and heat through for another two minutes.

entries.l1_note: 热透是 heat through；加热是 heat up / warm up。

entries.head: trim off

senses.en: to cut away unwanted parts

example.en: Trim off the fat before you slice the meat.

entries.l1_note: 修掉是 trim off；trim 单独是修剪。

entries.head: skim off

senses.en: to remove a layer from the surface of liquid

example.en: Skim off the foam while the broth simmers.
example.zh: 汤炖着的时候把浮沫撇掉。

entries.l1_note: 撇去是 skim off；skim 单独是略读。

entries.head: mash up

senses.en: to crush food into a soft mass

example.en: Mash up the potatoes while they're hot.

entries.l1_note: 捣泥是 mash up；mash-up 名词是混搭。

entries.head: spoon out

senses.en: to serve something with a spoon

example.en: Spoon out the batter into the pan.
example.zh: 把面糊一勺勺舀进锅里。

entries.l1_note: 舀出是 spoon out；scoop 更偏大勺。
